expected_effect.reading: No cell reaches the 2 bp minimum effect in the cheaper direction. Urgency: IS -0.2 to -0.6 bps (n.s.), POV within 0.1 bps, TWAP/VWAP DEARER at 1-2 % ADV (+1.7 ± 0.5 and +2.0 ± 0.5 bps TWAP, +0.8 to +2.5 bps VWAP) with 6-10 pp HIGHER fill rate: the adverse-crossing arm buys completion at a price. Pacing: within ±1 bp everywhere (VWAP 0.5 % +0.8 ± 0.3). AC drift: identical to plain AC in every cell (difference 0.00): at the registered beta (|expected_return| <= 4e-7) the drift is far below the temporary-impact scale, the arm is inert. Shares: no_signal 21-33 % (QQQ outside EQ10's universe), agree 13-46 %, adverse 10-28 %. The registered EQ10 sign is opposite to its real in-sample IC, so agree/adverse may be swapped relative to the true direction; an in-sample refit arm was not run. Expected effect for the gate under this configuration: none in the cheaper direction; the fresh test is expected to FAIL unless the alpha/thresholds decision changes the arm.
